Macklin Celebrini.summary: Celebrini recorded three assists, including one on the power play, and six shots on goal in Saturday's 4-3 loss to the Stars.
Celebrini scored a goal on six shots and added two PIM in Friday's 4-1 loss to the Wild.

Evan Bouchard.summary: Bouchard scored a power-play goal on three shots, dished an assist and added two PIM in Thursday's 5-4 loss to the Ducks.
Bouchard scored a goal and added a power-play assist in Tuesday's 4-3 shootout loss to the Devils.

Moritz Seider.summary: Seider recorded two assists in Monday's 5-3 win over the Panthers.
Seider notched two assists, two shots on goal, four hits and four blocked shots in Saturday's 4-3 shootout win over the Sharks.

Jack Hughes.summary: Hughes notched two assists, including one on the power play, and fired three shots on net in Sunday's 4-0 win over the Maple Leafs.
Hughes scored the game-winning goal, recorded a power-play assist and fired five shots on net in Saturday's 5-4 overtime win over the Islanders.

Cutter Gauthier.summary: Gauthier scored three goals on six shots, added an assist and went plus-2 in Sunday's 5-2 win over the Penguins.
Gauthier scored a goal on four shots and went plus-2 in Friday's 5-3 win over the Flames.

Chychrun notched two assists, four shots on goal and five blocked shots in Saturday's 4-3 overtime win over the Sabres.

Alex Tuch.summary: Tuch scored a goal on three shots in Saturday's 4-3 win over the Panthers.

Bedard picked up two assists while adding four shots on net, two hits, two PIM and a plus-1 rating in Wednesday's 5-3 loss to the Panthers.
